sentences.en: Pop artists thrive on the adulation of their loyal fans.
sentences.zh: 波普艺术家们依赖于他们忠实粉丝的崇拜。

sentences.en: It is certain that Lucy will marry the pop singer.
sentences.zh: 可以肯定的是露西会嫁给那位流行歌手。

sentences.en: My brother is interested in what you call pop music.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟对你们所说的流行音乐很感兴趣。
